summary: United Microelectronics Corp filed a Form 6-K announcing differences between its 2025 consolidated financial statements prepared under TIFRSs and IFRS Accounting Standards. The filing discloses net income, EPS, assets, liabilities, and equity under both frameworks, attributing variances to timing of additional income tax on unappropriated earnings and treasury stock accounting. This is a routine financial reporting disclosure, not a special situation event. No deal terms, board actions, or strategic changes are involved. No further action is required from an event-driven perspective.
